`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module arbiter #(
    parameter PORTS = 4,
    parameter ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK_ACK = 1,
    parameter ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input  wire                     clk,
    input  wire                     rst,
    input  wire [PORTS-1:0]         request,
    input  wire [PORTS-1:0]         acknowledge,
    output wire [PORTS-1:0]         grant,
    output wire                     grant_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded
);

reg [PORTS-1:0] grant_reg = 0, grant_next;
reg grant_valid_reg = 0, grant_valid_next;
reg [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded_reg = 0, grant_encoded_next;
reg [PORTS-1:0] mask_reg = 0, mask_next;

assign grant = grant_reg;
assign grant_valid = grant_valid_reg;
assign grant_encoded = grant_encoded_reg;

wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request = request & mask_reg;
wire request_valid = |request;
wire masked_request_valid = |masked_request;
wire use_masked = ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN && masked_request_valid;
wire [PORTS-1:0] plain_winner;
wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_winner;
wire [PORTS-1:0] plain_next_mask;
wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_next_mask;
wire [PORTS-1:0] selected_winner = use_masked ? masked_winner : plain_winner;
wire [PORTS-1:0] selected_mask = use_masked ? masked_next_mask : plain_next_mask;
wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] selected_index;

genvar i, b;
generate
    for (i = 0; i < PORTS; i = i + 1) begin : priority_bits
        if (ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb_priority
            if (i == 0) begin : first_bit
                assign plain_winner[i] = request[i];
                assign masked_winner[i] = masked_request[i];
                assign plain_next_mask[i] = 1'b0;
                assign masked_next_mask[i] = 1'b0;
            end else begin : other_bits
                assign plain_winner[i] = request[i] & ~(|request[i-1:0]);
                assign masked_winner[i] = masked_request[i] & ~(|masked_request[i-1:0]);
                assign plain_next_mask[i] = |request[i-1:0];
                assign masked_next_mask[i] = |masked_request[i-1:0];
            end
        end else begin : msb_priority
            if (i == PORTS-1) begin : first_bit
                assign plain_winner[i] = request[i];
                assign masked_winner[i] = masked_request[i];
                assign plain_next_mask[i] = 1'b0;
                assign masked_next_mask[i] = 1'b0;
            end else begin : other_bits
                assign plain_winner[i] = request[i] & ~(|request[PORTS-1:i+1]);
                assign masked_winner[i] = masked_request[i] & ~(|masked_request[PORTS-1:i+1]);
                assign plain_next_mask[i] = |request[PORTS-1:i+1];
                assign masked_next_mask[i] = |masked_request[PORTS-1:i+1];
            end
        end
    end
    for (b = 0; b < $clog2(PORTS); b = b + 1) begin : encode_bits
        wire [PORTS-1:0] terms;
        for (i = 0; i < PORTS; i = i + 1) begin : encode_terms
            if ((i >> b) & 1) begin : included
                assign terms[i] = selected_winner[i];
            end else begin : excluded
                assign terms[i] = 1'b0;
            end
        end
        assign selected_index[b] = |terms;
    end
endgenerate

always @* begin
    grant_next = 0;
    grant_valid_next = 0;
    grant_encoded_next = 0;
    mask_next = mask_reg;

    if (ARB_BLOCK && !ARB_BLOCK_ACK && (|(grant_reg & request))) begin
        grant_next = grant_reg;
        grant_valid_next = grant_valid_reg;
        grant_encoded_next = grant_encoded_reg;
    end else if (ARB_BLOCK && ARB_BLOCK_ACK && grant_valid_reg && !(|(grant_reg & acknowledge))) begin
        grant_next = grant_reg;
        grant_valid_next = grant_valid_reg;
        grant_encoded_next = grant_encoded_reg;
    end else if (request_valid) begin
        grant_next = selected_winner;
        grant_valid_next = 1'b1;
        grant_encoded_next = selected_index;
        if (ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN) begin
            mask_next = selected_mask;
        end
    end
end

always @(posedge clk) begin
    grant_reg <= grant_next;
    grant_valid_reg <= grant_valid_next;
    grant_encoded_reg <= grant_encoded_next;
    mask_reg <= mask_next;
    if (rst) begin
        grant_reg <= 0;
        grant_valid_reg <= 0;
        grant_encoded_reg <= 0;
        mask_reg <= 0;
    end
end

endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The supplied mapped paths show substantial combinational depth and buffering between registers, but do not identify exact RTL endpoints. A plausible contributor in the reference is the masked priority-encoding path followed by encoded-index decoding or variable-shift mask generation and blocking/reset selection.",
  "rewrite": "Replace the helper instances with top-local parallel priority suppression. Produce each one-hot winner directly from its request bit and a reduction of higher-priority requests. Encode the selected winner with OR reductions. Most importantly, compute each next-mask bit directly from a reduction of higher-priority requests, independently of the encoded index: for MSB priority, mask bit i is the OR of requests above i; for LSB priority, it is the OR below i. Select between masked and unmasked results while retaining the original blocking and sequential update rules.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Unmeasured. The rewrite removes the encoded-index-to-one-hot decode and encoded-index-to-variable-shift dependencies, particularly shortening the prospective mask-register feedback path. Balanced reductions may also reduce priority-selection depth. Actual WNS improvement over the supplied 7.8 ns baseline requires synthesis and STA at the fixed settings.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Parallel overlapping reductions can increase combinational area, routing, and fanout, although synthesis may share common terms. Register count is unchanged. Compliance with the 4880.43072 um2 mapped-area cap is not established without mapping.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the top interface, parameter names/defaults, original register initialization values, single positive-edge clock, synchronous active-high reset, blocking conditions, and output latency. Handles arbitrary multi-bit request and acknowledge vectors without input one-hot assumptions. A held grant also holds the round-robin mask; an idle cycle clears grant outputs while retaining the mask. No helper module is redefined. Equivalence against the original frozen RTL under the unchanged startup contract, including later resets, remains to be verified."
}
